ηγεμων.def: a leader, guide; a commander; a governor (of a province); plur: leaders.

ηγεομαι.def: (a) I lead, (b) I think, am of opinion, suppose, consider.

ηδη.def: already; now at length, now after all this waiting.

ηδονη.def: pleasure, a pleasure, especially sensuous pleasure; a strong desire, passion.

ηκω.def: I have come, am present, have arrived.

ηλικια.def: age, term of life; full age, maturity; stature.

ηλικοσ.def: of which size, of what size, how small, how much.

ημερα.def: a day, the period from sunrise to sunset.

ηρ.def: Er, son of Joshua and father of Elmadam.

ηρωδησ.def: Herod; four persons are called by this name: Herod the Great, Herod Antipas, Herod Agrippa, and Herod Agrippa the younger.

ηρωδιανοι.gloss: the Herodians, the partisans of Herod Antipas
ηρωδιανοι.def: the Herodians, the partisans of Herod (Antipas).

ηρωδιασ.def: Herodias (died after A.D. 40), daughter of Aristobulus and granddaughter of Herod I, wife, first, of her uncle Herod, second, of his half-brother, her uncle Herod Antipas.

ηρωδιων.def: Herodion, a Christian in Rome, a relative of Paul.

ησαυ.def: Esau, elder son of Isaac the patriarch, brother of Jacob.

ησυχαζω.gloss: I rest, am silent, live quietly
ησυχαζω.def: I rest from work, cease from altercation, am silent, live quietly.

ητταομαι.def: I am defeated, am overcome, am made inferior.

ηχεω.gloss: I make a sound, sound when struck
ηχεω.def: I make a sound, give forth a sound, sound (when struck); I roar (as the sea).

ηχοσ.def: (a) a sound, noise, (b) a rumor, report.
